name: CuHalide Atlas
applicationCategory: Scientific database and evidence-grounded retrieval system
description: Prepublication review implementation for an evidence-grounded, structure-resolved Cu(I) chloride, bromide and iodide knowledge portal. Current Curated rev.10 is reviewed through 2026-09-14; CuXplore source indexing was synchronized on 2026-09-24. The active runtime includes Structured Photophysics 1.4.0, Organic Components 1.2.0, a 1,322-record semantic layer and a 403-DOI / 727-document / 6,275-block source index. Direct-link access is query-and-view, search-engine indexing is disabled, and no permanent DOI, blanket license or formal public-release date is asserted until owner approval.
